questions.question: What do you use to write in your notebook?
questions.explanation: A pen (or pencil) is used for writing.

questions.question: A teacher works in a school.
questions.explanation: Yes, a teacher works in a school to help students learn.

questions.question: We read books in the school _______.
questions.explanation: The library is where we read and borrow books at school.

questions.question: What do students sit on in class?
questions.explanation: Students sit on chairs in the classroom.

questions.question: Name three things you find in a classroom.
questions.answer: desk, chair, board (or: book, pen, pencil)
questions.explanation: Classroom items include: desk, chair, board, book, pen, pencil.

questions.question: We play football in the classroom.
questions.explanation: We play football in the playground, not the classroom.

questions.question: Where do students play during break time?
questions.explanation: Students play in the playground during break time.

questions.question: The teacher writes on the _______.
questions.explanation: Teachers write on the board (blackboard or whiteboard) in class.

questions.question: What do you carry your books in?
questions.explanation: A school bag (or backpack) is used to carry books and school items.

questions.question: Do you like school? Why?
questions.answer: Yes, I like school because I learn new things / make friends.
questions.explanation: Students learn, make friends, and have fun at school.
